Private Villa Renovation

Residential Renovation · Chouf, Mount Lebanon · 2026

How can an existing stone villa support contemporary family life without losing the character that defines it? The project begins with a precise reading of the building, then separates every intervention clearly across existing, demolition, construction and furnished plans.

The design reorganizes the ground floor around a more open kitchen and breakfast area, with a clearer relationship between reception and family living. New openings and terraces add measured outdoor space while working carefully with the existing structure.

Paired sections and axonometric views make the existing-to-proposed transformation legible, while demolition and construction plans translate the design decisions into a clear architectural package for consultants and contractors to build upon.
